concept.title: Step 2: restate each listing
concept.shortdesc: The language model fills in its form for each listing, which is what separates the dimensions.

conbody.p: The language model fills in its form for each listing: the kind of record, each distinct thing on offer, who it says it is for, any restrictions, and who provides it.
This is the step that separates the dimensions. A listing that bundles several services is split into one entry for each.
